dossier_meta.catalog_title: Fractional Chromatic Number Bound for Planar Triangle-Free Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: The fractional chromatic number of $n$-vertex planar triangle-free graphs might be bounded by $3 - 3/(n+1)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Since $\alpha(G) \geq |V(G)|/\chi_f(G)$, the bound $\alpha(G) \geq (n+1)/3$ from Steinberg–Tovey and Theorem 2 indicate this potential upper bound on $\chi_f$. Dvořák et al. [6] confirmed it for planar triangle-free graphs of maximum degree at most 4; in general only the weaker bound $3 - 3/(3n+1)$ is known.
